newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Designer Textiles downgrades 96/97 profit forecast.
newsitem.headline: Designer Textiles downgrades 96/97 profit forecast.

text.p: Designer Textiles on Monday downgraded by 20 percent its profit forecast for the year ending June 30, 1997.

Directors told shareholders at the company's annual meeting the revised forecast came solely on the back of poorer results from the New Zealand operations, which continue to be affected by depressed market conditions.
